relations.text: 50年以上にわたり地域路線の運航を担う提携先
relations.text_en: A regional partner for more than 50 years

source.quote: Republic Airways has maintained a partnership with American Airlines and its predecessors for more than 50 years, which Republic believes is a result of Republic's distinct focus on operational excellence.

source.quote: In August 2022, Air Wisconsin entered into a capacity purchase agreement (the "American capacity purchase agreement") with American Airlines, Inc.

source.quote: As of December 31, 2024, our largest E-Jet customers by number of aircraft in service were SkyWest, Republic, American Airlines, KLM, Mesa, Azul, Tianjn, LOT Polish, Horizon Air and Porter.
